body:
#1981 / TASK-1272 APPROVED at 4a3c433d6ad6. A standing refusal is cleared.

STORY-1419 EARNED ITS KEEP - this is exactly the case it was built for. My
sweep caught the head moving past a blocking verdict (reviewed f4e2cb3c67 ->
head 4a3c433d6a); nothing else would have told me the rework had landed.
Worth noting the refusal was the HEADLESS DRAIN REVIEWER's, and that seat has
exited - so this is one of the 7-of-15 you and I discussed where a
seat-scoped row reaches nobody. I picked it up off the sweep, not off a
notification. STORY-1420 is still the thing that closes that.

I REVIEWED IT RATHER THAN CLEARED IT. I did not author any commit on the
branch and the refusing seat is gone, so forming my own verdict is in role -
unlike #2033, where the drain-reviewer refusal stands and there is rework I
have no independent basis to pass on.

THE FIX IS BETTER THAN THE FINDING ASKED FOR, and I want the implementer
credited for the part I did not request. An intermediate commit (c674af1c3d)
added a phase-name check - `start == Reviewer -> Ci`. 4a3c433d6a REPLACED it
with `ci_gated_start_phase(start, ci_green)`, keyed on the fact, and the doc
comment states why the phase-name version was insufficient: recorded Ci
against a probed MERGE skips CI too, and no Reviewer-only check catches it.
That is half-fix-leaves-the-shape spotted and avoided by the author of the
remedy - which is the thing we said authors cannot usually do.

WHAT I VERIFIED, since the helper being right is not the claim:
  - WIRING: called at lib.rs:78602 in handle_from_pr, replacing the inline
    check. A correct unit behind an unwired seam is this week's recurring
    defect and it is the first thing I looked for.
  - THE FACT IT KEYS ON: a gate fed a stale input is the same defect one door
    over. facts.ci_green is a CURRENT-HEAD forge probe on both paths
    (probe_resume_facts in drain_cmd.rs, and the seeded-PR refresh at
    lib.rs:78536), and only CiProbe::Green counts - so a PENDING pipeline
    reads not-green and HOLDS at Ci. Terminal-green is what is required.
  - The requested integration test exists and drives the real path.

ONE FINDING RECORDED THAT IS NOT A DEFECT, deliberately: the original
finding's first half - "from_pr_plan never returns CI and ignores
facts.ci_green" - is STILL TRUE at this head, by design, and a new test pins
that contract. The defect is closed by gating AFTER reconciliation. I recorded
it because someone re-reading the old finding to check the fix will find the
described behaviour intact and could conclude it was not addressed.

MERGE-READINESS NOT ESTABLISHED and recorded as the second finding: Build
in_progress, hold armed, BLOCKED. Code verdict only. Same as #1974 - yours to
clear and merge when green, and I will re-verify head-unmoved if you want it
before you do.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: #1981 TASK-1272 APPROVED at 4a3c433d6a - drain-reviewer refusal cleared; fix is fact-keyed, wiring + input provenance both verified
